This is assault on a police officer performing duty, likely "妨害公务" (obstructing public duty) or "暴力抗拒执行职务" (resisting law enforcement). In Chinese criminal law, the crime is "妨害公务" (obstructing official duties) or "暴力抗拒执行职务" is a specific offense under Article 277? Actually Article 277: "暴力、威胁方法阻碍国家机关工作人员依法执行职务的，处三年以下有期徒刑、拘役或者管制". That's "妨害公务". The examples: earlier example with "阻碍介休市交警大队民警依法执行公务" gave answer "妨害公务". So similar: they blocked police officer, used violence. So answer: 妨害公务.

Check if any other crimes like "非法拘禁"? No. "故意伤害"? They damaged uniform but not bodily injury. So main crime is "妨害公务". Possibly also "聚众斗殴"? But the main is obstruction of duty. So answer: [罪名]妨害公务<eoa>.
